# Sequire Consulting

> Sequire Consulting is a strategy and legal consultancy for African businesses, especially MSMEs, working with clients across Africa from its head office in Lagos, Nigeria. It helps businesses develop a coherent strategy and puts the legal and operational structures in place to carry it out. Sequire was founded in November 2024 by Nsikan Efo. It is a Christian business, and its strategy work is Spirit-led.

Sequire works with MSMEs, nonprofits, new founders and growth-stage organisations across Nigeria and Africa, remotely and on-site. Clients have come from agriculture, wellness, logistics, healthcare, media and technology.

## Services

- [Sequire Seed, launch strategy](https://www.sequireconsulting.com/services/business-setup-and-launch-strategy/): For founders starting a business in Nigeria. We research the market, choose the right legal structure, establish the business entity and prepare the documents and processes you need to launch. Most engagements take 3 to 6 months.
- [Sequire Solve, stabilisation strategy](https://www.sequireconsulting.com/services/business-diagnostics-and-process-improvement/): For businesses with recurring operational or compliance problems. We find the cause through a business diagnostic and an optional legal audit, then fix it with clear processes, written SOPs and staff training. Most engagements take 3 to 6 months.
- [Sequire Transform, growth strategy](https://www.sequireconsulting.com/services/growth-and-market-entry-strategy/): For established organisations entering a new market, launching a product or restructuring. We develop the growth strategy and put the legal and operational structure in place to support it. Engagements take between 6 months and 3 years, depending on the scale of the change.
- [Sequire Plus, strategic and legal retainership](https://www.sequireconsulting.com/services/strategic-and-legal-retainer/): Ongoing strategic and legal support for your business. We advise on decisions as they arise, handle contracts and regulatory filings, keep your statutory records in order and track regulatory changes. A long-term retainer, with the scope agreed in advance.

Fees are based on estimated hours per workstream, with 50 to 70% of the fee paid upfront and, for project-based engagements, the balance at the end of the project. Eligible founders can access subsidised fees and equity-based arrangements through the Sequire Seed Fund.
